verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a deployment platform, so per-pull-request preview environments are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no automatic preview URL created for each PR. Shipping from GitHub via `fly launch` and Sprites each having an HTTPS URL are adjacent features: neither describes automatic per-PR preview deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request
